evidence.code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title('Solar cold room section - airflow and insulation')
# walls
import matplotlib.patches as patches
ax.add_patch(patches.Rectangle((1,1), 6, 3.5, fill=False, linewidth=3))
ax.text(4, 0.5, '100mm PU walls + floor + roof')
ax.text(4, 5.0, 'PV shade roof above')
ax.plot([1,7],[5.2,5.2], linewidth=4)
# crates
for x in [2,3.5,5]:
  ax.add_patch(patches.Rectangle((x,1.5), 1.0, 1.0, fill=False))
  ax.text(x+0.1, 1.9, 'produce')
# evaporator + fan
ax.add_patch(patches.Rectangle((1.2,3.8), 1.5, 0.5, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax.text(1.3, 4.0, 'evaporator+fan')
ax.annotate('', xy=(6.5,3.5), xytext=(2.7,4.0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax.text(4.5, 4.2, 'cold air loop')
ax.annotate('', xy=(2.0,3.0), xytext=(6.0,2.5), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax.text(4.0, 2.8, 'return air')
# condenser outside
ax.add_patch(patches.Rectangle((7.5,1.5), 1.5, 1.0, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax.text(7.6, 1.9, 'condenser')
ax.plot([7,7.5],[3.5,2.2], linewidth=2); ax.plot([7,7.5],[3.3,2.0], linewidth=2)
ax.text(7.0, 3.0, 'hot reject')
ax.plot([3,3.5],[1.0,0.3], linewidth=2); ax.text(3.6,0.3,'condensate drain')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=150)
evidence.output_summary: Insulated cold room section with evaporator fan airflow over produce crates, 100mm PU walls, condenser heat rejection outside, condensate drain.
